recent.text: The Texans lose to the Browns and fall to 3-6. After a hot start, C.J. Stroud and their offense totally stalled in the 2nd half and had just 2 drives with a first down. Their season is essentially over before Thanksgiving.

recent.text: Xavier Hutchinson is solid and makes a ton of plays and surprises many of us with plays he makes.. but why does C.J. Stroud love him THAT much? Gets too many critical targets in crucial situations either covered or double covered.
